title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
title_zh: 学习何时人类决策至关重要：LLM智能体的执行者相对咨询价值

paragraphs.en: Large language models increasingly automate complex tasks, but human decision capacity does not scale with their capabilities. In many applications, humans remain essential for providing private context, authority, or judgments unavailable to the agent. We formulate human decision capacity allocation : given multiple consultation opportunities and a limited budget, at which decisions should an LLM agent consult a human? The central challenge is estimating consultation value , which is executor-dependent because the same human input may benefit different downstream agents differently. We introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD) , which estimates consultation values offline using Monte Carlo executor rollouts and distills these values into lightweight predictors for budgeted allocation, requiring no rollout-based value estimation at deployment. Across five batch and three sequential settings with two frontier executors, CVD improves allocation through joint and continuation-aware value learning, while independent consultation values remain competitive in several settings. CVD also broadly outperforms direct prompting and Value of Information Dong et al. (2026) where applicable, remains robust with substantially less rollout supervision, and enables nearly lossless approximate allocation at low search cost.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of performing complex knowledge-work tasks, including repository-level software engineering, natural-language planning, and collaborative document creation ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . As the amount of work that agents can generate and execute grows, however, the human capacity available to supervise them does not scale accordingly. Humans remain essential in many real-world workflows because they possess information unavailable to the agent, exercise organizational authority, and provide judgments that cannot be inferred reliably from public context. A software engineer may know what a customer said minutes ago; a manager may know an unreleased roadmap decision; and among several technically valid code changes, only the responsible team may know which trade-off the organization prefers. Yet humans cannot be consulted at every decision point surfaced by increasingly productive agents.

paragraphs.en: Human decision capacity therefore becomes a scarce resource. Importantly, not every decision point deserves the same amount of human attention. Some can be handled reliably by the agent, while others have substantial downstream consequences if the agent acts without missing human information. Moreover, the apparent importance of a decision point is not the same as the value of consulting a human. A salient decision may require little human input when the executor already handles it correctly, whereas a routine decision may benefit greatly from a private fact the executor lacks. The allocation problem is therefore a decision made by the agent to decide where it should spend limited human capacity, given multiple consultation opportunities to ask for human input. The relevant question is not simply which decisions are important , but: Given a limited human consultation budget, at which decision points should the agent consult a human?
paragraphs.zh: 因此，人类的决策能力成为一种稀缺资源。 重要的是，并非每个决策点都值得投入同等数量的人类注意力。 有些决策点可以由智能体可靠地处理，而另一些决策点如果智能体在缺失人类信息的情况下采取行动，则会产生重大的下游后果。 此外，一个决策点的表面重要性并不等同于咨询人类的价值。 当执行者已经能正确处理某个显著的决策时，该决策可能只需要很少的人类输入；而一个常规决策却可能因为获得执行者所缺乏的私有信息而大为受益。 因此，分配问题是智能体所做出的一个决策，即在存在多次咨询机会、可以请求人类输入的情况下，决定应将有限的人类能力用在哪里。 相关的问题并不仅仅是哪些决策重要，而是：在人类咨询预算有限的情况下，智能体应该在哪些决策点咨询人类？

paragraphs.en: We study this problem as human decision-capacity allocation . We assume that candidate consultation points have already been identified and focus on allocating a limited human budget among them to obtain the corresponding information, judgment, or authority. The central challenge is estimating consultation value , the expected utility gain from resolving a decision or a set of decisions, before consulting. Once these values are known, budgeted allocation is comparatively direct. We observe that consultation value is executor-relative : it depends not only on the decision itself, but also on what the executor already knows and how effectively it can use the human input. We study both batch settings, where multiple consultations are chosen jointly and may be complementary or redundant, and sequential settings, where consultation opportunities arrive over time and using capacity now incurs an opportunity cost for future decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一问题作为人类决策能力分配来研究。 我们假设候选咨询点已经被识别出来，并专注于在其中分配有限的人类预算，以获取相应的信息、判断或决策权。 核心挑战是在咨询之前估计咨询价值，即解决某个决策或一组决策所带来的期望效用增益。 一旦这些价值已知，预算内的分配就相对直接。 我们观察到，咨询价值是相对于执行者的：它不仅取决于决策本身，还取决于执行者已经知道什么，以及它能多有效地利用人类输入。 我们同时研究批量场景和顺序场景：前者中多个咨询被联合选择，可能互补或冗余；后者中咨询机会随时间到来，现在使用能力会对未来决策产生机会成本。

paragraphs.en: Prior work studies selective human intervention and clarification ( Mozannar and Sontag, 2020 ; Hoque et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Most closely, Dong et al. (2026) formulate multi-turn clarification as a clarify-or-commit process, selecting among candidate questions by their inference-time Value of Information (VoI) relative to communication cost. We allocate a shared consultation budget across multiple decision opportunities, accounting for set-level interactions and sequential opportunity costs. More broadly, our formulation extends resource-aware agentic inference ( Achille and Soatto, 2026 ) from allocating computation to allocating scarce human consultation by downstream value.

paragraphs.en: To estimate consultation value, we introduce Consultation Value Distillation (CVD) , as illustrated in Figure 1 . We sample consultation choices offline and use Monte Carlo executor rollouts to estimate downstream utility, then distill these outcomes into a lightweight predictor using information available at decision time. In batch settings, a permutation-invariant set-value model scores complete consultation sets, capturing complementarity and redundancy among human inputs. In sequential settings, a continuation-aware predictor accounts for both the current consultation and the remaining human budget. At deployment, the allocator uses these predicted values to select consultations under the available budget without rollout-based value estimation. We use a small ensemble of predictors for robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 为了估计咨询价值，我们提出了咨询价值蒸馏（CVD），如图 1 所示。 我们离线采样咨询选择，并使用蒙特卡洛执行器 rollout 来估计下游效用，然后利用决策时可获得的信息将这些结果蒸馏到一个轻量级预测器中。 在批量设置中，一个置换不变的集合价值模型对完整的咨询集合进行评分，捕捉人类输入之间的互补性和冗余性。 在序贯设置中，一个感知后续步骤的预测器同时考虑当前咨询和剩余的人类预算。 在部署时，分配器使用这些预测价值在可用预算下选择咨询，无需基于 rollout 的价值估计。 我们使用一个小的预测器集成来增强鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate CVD across five batch and three sequential settings spanning six tasks, covering information acquisition, planning, scheduling, preference elicitation, and controlled decision interactions. Main results are replicated under Sonnet 5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, using executor outcomes independent of training supervision. CVD provides clear gains from joint batch and continuation-aware sequential allocation. At the largest evaluated budgets, it significantly outperforms the Local Value baseline, reaching normalized gain 0.58 / 0.40 0.58/0.40 vs. 0.25 / 0.09 0.25/0.09 on batch Animals and 0.91 0.91 – 0.96 0.96 vs. 0.80 0.80 – 0.87 0.87 on sequential ThinkingBox. Local Value remains competitive on several other tasks. At these budgets, our VoI baseline achieves at most 0.18 0.18 normalized gain, well below CVD on batch and sequential Animals. Ablations support direct total-value regression as a strong default, while the benefits of explicit decomposition and ranking objectives depend on the task and executor. Ensembling improves robustness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在跨越六个任务的五个批处理设置和三个顺序设置上评估 CVD，涵盖信息获取、规划、调度、偏好引出和受控决策交互。 主要结果在 Sonnet 5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 下得到复现，所用执行器结果独立于训练监督。 CVD 通过联合的批处理与具备连续性感知的顺序分配带来了明显的收益。 在所评估的最大预算下，它显著优于 Local Value 基线，在批处理 Animals 上达到归一化收益 0.58 / 0.40 0.58/0.40，而基线为 0.25 / 0.09 0.25/0.09；在顺序 ThinkingBox 上为 0.91 0.91 – 0.96 0.96，而基线为 0.80 0.80 – 0.87 0.87。 Local Value 在其他若干任务上仍具竞争力。 在这些预算下，我们的 VoI 基线最多取得 0.18 0.18 的归一化收益，远低于 CVD 在批处理和顺序 Animals 上的表现。 消融实验支持将直接总价值回归作为强默认选择，而显式分解与排序目标的收益则取决于任务和执行器。 集成方法提升了鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Consultation value is difficult to infer directly from task context alone: an LLM may recognize that information is missing without knowing whether obtaining it will actually improve its own downstream execution. We therefore learn consultation value from observed executor outcomes rather than relying only on direct prompting. Our approach uses offline distillation : for a given executor and task, we collect Monte Carlo rollouts under alternative consultation choices, aggregate them into consultation-value supervision, and distill this supervision into a lightweight predictor. This amortizes the cost of estimating downstream value across many future decisions and avoids repeatedly performing expensive rollout-based evaluation during allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 咨询价值很难仅凭任务上下文直接推断：大语言模型可能意识到信息缺失，却不知道获取该信息是否真的能改进其自身的下游执行。 因此，我们从观察到的执行结果中学习咨询价值，而不是仅仅依赖直接提示。 我们的方法采用离线蒸馏：对于给定的智能体和任务，我们在不同咨询选择下收集蒙特卡洛 rollout，将其聚合为咨询价值监督信号，并将该监督信号蒸馏到一个轻量级预测器中。 这样可以将估计下游价值的成本分摊到许多未来决策上，并避免在分配过程中反复进行昂贵的基于 rollout 的评估。

paragraphs.en: Direct prompting is substantially weaker than learned allocation on most benchmarks, suggesting that task knowledge alone does not identify the most useful consultations. On Flight under Sonnet, CVD also performs best ( 0.33 0.33 vs. 0.24 0.24 Prompt and 0.18 0.18 VoI). Allowing VoI to generate follow-up questions beyond our predefined candidates improves its Sonnet 5 performance on sequential Animals (Appendix E.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在大多数基准测试上，直接提示明显弱于学习到的分配，这表明仅凭任务知识并不能识别出最有用的咨询。 在批量 Animals 任务上，CVD 在两种执行器下都大幅优于 VoI 基线（0.58 对 0.05 和 0.40 对 0.17），在序贯设置中也有类似的差距。 在使用 Sonnet 的 Flight 任务上，CVD 同样表现最佳（0.33 对 Prompt 的 0.24 和 VoI 的 0.18）。 允许 VoI 在预定义候选之外生成后续问题，提高了其在序贯 Animals 任务上使用 Sonnet 5 的性能（附录 E.3）。

paragraphs.en: CVD fails on Flight Recommendation under Sol, obtaining clipped NG 0 0 versus 0.29 0.29 for prompting and 0.09 0.09 for Local Value, although neither difference is significant. Unlike on other batch benchmarks, CVD often stops before exhausting the budget; forcing exactly B B consultations improves performance (Appendix E.4 ). Sol already performs strongly without consultation, leaving little headroom, and its remaining consultation-value structure is difficult to learn from the small training set. Section 7.2 shows that the failure is specific to learning Sol’s value structure rather than to allocation for this executor.

paragraphs.en: CVD improves allocation by considering consultations jointly and accounting for valuable later opportunities, while Local Value remains competitive in several settings.
paragraphs.zh: CVD 通过联合考虑会诊并计入宝贵的后续机会来改进分配，而 Local Value 在若干场景中仍具竞争力。

paragraphs.en: CVD directly regresses total executor-relative consultation value without imposing an explicit factorization. We additionally evaluated explicit local-plus-interaction decompositions, variants that incorporate local-value estimates as auxiliary inputs or losses, relative and ranking-based objectives, and simpler predictors. Complete ablation results are presented in Appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: CVD 直接对以执行者为参照的总咨询价值进行回归，而无需引入显式的因子分解。 我们还评估了显式的「局部加交互」分解、将局部价值估计作为辅助输入或损失项的变体、相对与基于排序的目标函数，以及更简单的预测器。 完整的消融实验结果见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: A matched additive control under Sonnet 5 shows that, with set-level supervision and preprocessing fixed, removing the additive constraint significantly improves Animals at B = 3 B=3 (+0.25 NG) and Meeting Planning at B = 2 B=2 (+0.12 NG), with no significant differences elsewhere (Appendix G.1 ). Under the main training protocol, alternatives significantly outperform direct regression in 3 of 147 benchmark–budget comparisons and underperform it in 22 with Sonnet 5. And with GPT-6.1 Sol, the corresponding counts are 13 and 14. Four of the five explicit decompositions remain significantly worse on Meeting Planning at B = 4 B=4 under Sonnet 5. A possible source of difficulty is error propagation: errors in estimated singleton values can propagate to predictions for every set containing the corresponding consultation. Direct regression learns the value of the complete allocation without requiring separate singleton estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Sonnet 5 下的匹配加性对照实验表明，在集合级监督和预处理固定的情况下，移除加性约束显著提升了 B = 3 B=3 下的 Animals（+0.25 NG）和 B = 2 B=2 下的 Meeting Planning（+0.12 NG），其他地方没有显著差异（附录 G.1）。 在主训练协议下，在 147 个基准–预算比较中，替代方法在 3 个比较中显著优于直接回归，在 Sonnet 5 下有 22 个比较显著劣于直接回归。 而在 GPT-6.1 Sol 下，相应的数量分别为 13 和 14。 在 Sonnet 5 下，五种显式分解中的四种在 B = 4 B=4 的 Meeting Planning 上仍然显著更差。 一个可能的困难来源是误差传播：对估计的单元素值的误差可能传播到包含相应 consultation 的每个集合的预测中。 直接回归学习完整分配的价值，而无需单独的单元素估计。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we study the practical cost of CVD and whether a value predictor trained for one executor can be reused with another. We first vary the amount of offline supervision and deployment time consultation set search, then evaluate cross-executor transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们研究 CVD 的实际成本，以及为一个执行器训练的价值预测器能否被另一个执行器复用。 我们首先改变离线监督的数量和部署时的咨询集搜索，然后评估跨执行器的迁移。

paragraphs.en: For the supervision ablations, we report retention, the reduced supervision allocator’s gain ( U ¯ \bar{U} ) over random ( U ¯ random \bar{U}_{\mathrm{random}} ) relative to that of the default supervision allocator ( U ¯ default \bar{U}_{\mathrm{default}} ):
paragraphs.zh: 对于监督消融实验，我们报告保留率（retention），即缩减监督分配器的增益（Ū）相对于随机分配器（Ū_random）的增益，并以默认监督分配器（Ū_default）的增益为基准进行归一化：

paragraphs.en: Since the default supervision predictor is itself learned rather than an upper bound, retention may exceed 1 when reduced supervision performs better on the test set. We report retention unclipped with paired 95% confidence intervals. Values near one indicate similar gains to default supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 由于默认监督预测器本身是学习得到的而非性能上界，当降低监督后在测试集上表现更好时，保留率可能超过1。 我们报告未截断的保留率，并附上成对的95%置信区间。 接近1的数值表示与默认监督取得了相似的增益。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2(a) , CVD remains effective with fewer training executor calls. At their largest budgets, Animals and Trip retain at least 90% of the default supervision gain using 62% and 10% of the default training calls, respectively. Meeting retains at least 93% across budgets using 25% of the default calls, with no significant loss.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2(a) 所示，在训练执行器调用次数较少的情况下，CVD 仍然有效。 在最大预算下，Animals 和 Trip 分别仅使用默认训练调用次数的 62% 和 10%，就保留了至少 90% 的默认监督增益。 Meeting 仅使用默认调用次数的 25%，在各预算下都保持了至少 93% 的效果，且没有显著损失。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 2(a) , CVD remains effective with fewer training executor calls.
sents.zh: 如图 2(a) 所示，在训练执行器调用次数较少的情况下，CVD 仍然有效。

sents.en: At their largest budgets, Animals and Trip retain at least 90% of the default supervision gain using 62% and 10% of the default training calls, respectively.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 2(b) , CVD also does not require labels for all feasible consultation sets. Meeting Planning retains at least 93% of the default supervision gain using 20 labeled sets per task instead of 43 by default (5.2% versus 11.1% of the 386 feasible sets), while a quarter of the Animals sets retains at least 95%. Joint supervision nevertheless matters: singleton-only training reduces retention to 0.52 on Meeting at B = 4 B=4 and 0.55 on Animals at B = 3 B=3 , suggesting that broader set coverage is more useful than highly precise supervision over only a few sets.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 2(b) 所示，CVD 同样不需要对所有可行的咨询集合都提供标签。 在会议规划任务中，每个任务使用 20 个带标签集合而非默认的 43 个（占 386 个可行集合的 5.2%，而默认为 11.1%），仍能保留至少 93% 的默认监督收益；而在 Animals 任务中，仅使用四分之一的集合即可保留至少 95%。 然而联合监督仍然重要：仅使用单元素集合训练时，在 B = 4 的 Meeting 上保留率降至 0.52，在 B = 3 的 Animals 上降至 0.55，这表明更广泛的集合覆盖比对少数集合的高度精确监督更有用。

paragraphs.en: Learning-to-defer and algorithmic-triage methods decide when tasks should be handled by AI or transferred to human experts, including settings with finite human workload or oversight budgets ( Madras et al., 2018 ; Raghu et al., 2019 ; Mozannar and Sontag, 2020 ; Mozannar et al., 2023 ; Alves et al., 2024 ; Zavattari et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Related interactive imitation-learning and human-advice methods allocate limited human interventions during sequential execution ( Hoque et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Bareinboim, 2022 ; Min et al., 2025 ) . In our setting, the human does not replace the agent: a fixed LLM remains the executor, while scarce human capacity supplies information, judgment, or authority. We therefore optimize the downstream executor-relative value of consultation, including interactions among consultation opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟学习与算法分诊方法决定何时应将任务交由 AI 处理或转移给人类专家，包括人类工作量或监督预算有限的场景 ( Madras et al., 2018 ; Raghu et al., 2019 ; Mozannar and Sontag, 2020 ; Mozannar et al., 2023 ; Alves et al., 2024 ; Zavattari et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) 。 相关的交互式模仿学习与人类建议方法在顺序执行过程中分配有限的人类干预 ( Hoque et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Bareinboim, 2022 ; Min et al., 2025 ) 。 在我们的设定中，人类并不取代智能体：一个固定的 LLM 仍然是执行者，而稀缺的人类能力则提供信息、判断或授权。 因此，我们优化的是咨询相对于下游执行者的价值，包括各咨询机会之间的交互。

paragraphs.en: Prior work studies when and what LLM agents should ask users to clarify ambiguous intent, preferences, or missing information ( Andukuri et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Patel et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Ross et al., 2025 ; Suri et al., 2026 ; Gulati et al., 2026 ) . Most closely, Dong et al. (2026) formulate human–agent communication through Value of Information (VoI), reasoning over latent state, possible responses, and downstream utility at inference time. Their released estimator uses one-step lookahead over a finite answer space. CVD instead learns executor-relative consultation value from offline executor outcomes and allocates a shared human budget across batch or sequential decisions without response enumeration during allocation. Related learned metareasoning allocates limited internal computation by expected value ( Callaway et al., 2018 ) . We instead allocate external human decision capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作研究了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体何时以及应就何种内容向用户询问，以澄清模糊的意图、偏好或缺失的信息（Andukuri 等，2024；Zhang 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025；Huang 等，2025；Patel 等，2025；Wu 等，2025；Ross 等，2025；Suri 等，2026；Gulati 等，2026）。 与本文最接近的是，Dong 等 （2026）通过信息价值（Value of Information, VoI）对智能体与人的交流进行建模，在推理时对潜在状态、可能的回复以及下游效用进行推理。 他们发布的估计器在有限的答案空间上进行单步前瞻。 CVD 则从离线的执行器结果中学习相对于执行器的咨询价值，并在批处理或序贯决策之间分配共享的人类预算，且在分配过程中无需枚举回复。 相关的学习型元推理方法按期望值分配有限的内部计算资源（Callaway 等，2018）。 我们则是分配外部的人类决策能力。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents increasingly use search and planning to improve reasoning and interaction ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地使用搜索与规划来提升推理和交互能力（Hao 等，2023；Zhou 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）。 ExACT 使用 Reflective-MCTS 生成更强的行为，并将搜索经验蒸馏到一个成本更低的学习策略中（Yu 等，2025）。 与之类似，我们将昂贵的离线计算分摊到人类咨询选择而非环境动作上：执行器展开在离线阶段提供价值监督，而部署阶段无需基于展开的价值估计，可以使用廉价的近似子集搜索。

paragraphs.en: We study how agentic systems should allocate scarce human information, judgment, or authority across competing decisions. We formulate this as executor-relative human decision capacity allocation and introduce consultation value distillation, which learns from offline executor rollouts but requires no Monte Carlo rollouts at deployment. Across diverse tasks and two strong LLM executors, direct value learning provides a robust allocation strategy, suggesting a practical way to focus limited human attention where it has the greatest downstream impact.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究智能体系统应如何在相互竞争的决策之间分配稀缺的人类信息、判断力或权威。 我们将其形式化为相对于执行器的人类决策容量分配问题，并提出咨询价值蒸馏，它从离线的执行器轨迹中学习，但在部署时不需要蒙特卡洛模拟。 在多种任务和两个强大的大语言模型执行器上，直接价值学习提供了一种稳健的分配策略，为将有限的人类注意力聚焦于具有最大下游影响之处提供了一条实用途径。

paragraphs.en: Our study relies on simulated or benchmark-defined human responses rather than live human participants, and the evaluated consultation budgets are modest. Broader validation is needed to establish how well the approach transfers to human populations and real organizational settings. We also assume pre-specified consultation opportunities and use benchmark-specific pre-consultation features. Learning candidate consultations and transferable value predictors directly from raw task context remains open.

paragraphs.en: We adapt the Mixed 20Q animal game of Dong et al. (2026) . Each episode contains 100 candidate animals and a uniformly sampled hidden animal. Six Yes/No/Maybe questions are generated without access to the hidden animal, after removing degenerate and highly redundant questions. Consulting reveals the answer to one question, and the executor must identify the hidden animal from the candidate pool and revealed answers. Utility is 2 ​ Pr ⁡ ( correct ) − 1 2\Pr(\mathrm{correct})-1 . Animals supports both batch allocation over question sets and sequential allocation in which later questions may depend on earlier answers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们改编了 Dong 等人（2026）的混合 20Q 动物游戏。 每个回合包含 100 个候选动物和一个均匀采样的隐藏动物。 在去除退化和高度冗余的问题后，生成六个是/否/可能的问题，且生成时不接触隐藏动物。 咨询会揭示其中一个问题的答案，执行者必须从候选池和已揭示的答案中识别出隐藏动物。 效用为 2 ​ Pr ⁡ ( correct ) − 1 2\Pr(\mathrm{correct})-1。 Animals 支持针对问题集的批量分配，也支持顺序分配，其中后面的问题可能依赖前面的答案。

paragraphs.en: We adapt Trip Planning tasks from NaturalPlan Zheng et al. (2024) in which the executor must construct a multi-city itinerary satisfying stay durations, direct-flight constraints, and dated commitments. We hide the dates of three commitments while retaining the event and city in the public task; each consultation reveals one hidden date. We retain tasks for which the hidden commitments materially constrain the feasible itineraries. Utility is one iff the produced itinerary satisfies all public and hidden travel constraints. Trip Planning is evaluated in the batch setting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 NaturalPlan（Zheng 等人，2024）改编旅行规划任务。 在这些任务中，执行者必须构建满足停留时长、直飞航班约束和带日期约定的多城市行程。 我们隐藏三个约定的日期，同时在公开任务中保留事件和城市；每次咨询揭示一个隐藏日期。 我们保留那些隐藏约束能实质性限制可行行程的任务。 当且仅当生成的行程满足所有公开和隐藏的旅行约束时，效用为 1。 旅行规划在批量设置下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We adapt the flight-recommendation setting of Dong et al. (2026) , based on FLIGHTPREF Lin et al. (2022) . Five observed flight choices constrain a latent user preference, and the executor must recommend one of three query flights. The five released preference questions form the consultation candidates. Consulting reveals the user’s answer to the corresponding question. Utility is the released preference utility normalized between the expected worst and full-information choices. We evaluate Flight Recommendation in the batch setting.

paragraphs.en: We construct an IT-procurement workflow from ThinkingBox ( Li et al., 2026 ) . The workflow contains decisions about supplier, billing, and delivery notification, with additional compliance decisions triggered when required by the supplier choice. Each decision has 3–6 listed options; the hidden correct option is sampled uniformly from the interior options, excluding the first and last, and the order is not shuffled. A colleague’s note appears with probability 0.5 0.5 and, when present, names the correct option with probability 0.6 0.6 . An incorrect note names an option uniformly sampled from those other than the correct and first-listed options. A consultation reveals the correct option for an available decision. Utility aggregates correctness over the workflow, with higher-weight decisions requiring additional follow-up actions. TB-D supports both batch and sequential allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 ThinkingBox（Li et al., 2026）构建了一个 IT 采购工作流。 该工作流包含关于供应商、计费和交付通知的决策，当供应商选择需要时，还会触发额外的合规决策。 每个决策有 3–6 个列出的选项；隐藏的正确选项从内部选项中均匀抽样（排除第一个和最后一个），且顺序不做打乱。 同事的备注以 0.5 0.5 的概率出现，且在出现时以 0.6 0.6 的概率指出正确选项。 错误的备注所指的选项是从正确选项和首个列出选项之外的其他选项中均匀抽取的。 一次咨询会揭示某个可用决策的正确选项。 效用是对整个工作流正确性的聚合，权重较高的决策需要执行额外的后续操作。 TB-D 同时支持批量分配和顺序分配。

paragraphs.en: TB-H contains procurement, incident-response, and travel-booking workflows with nine or ten irreversible decisions. Earlier choices can create later obligations, enable options, make later answers inferable, or eliminate later decisions, creating continuation effects under a shared consultation budget. Each family has a coupled version in which these dependencies arise from earlier decisions and a matched control in which the same triggers depend on independent public randomness. One consultation opportunity is available per decision. TB-H is evaluated sequentially.
paragraphs.zh: TB-H 包含采购、事件响应和差旅预订三类工作流，每个工作流含有九到十个不可逆决策。 较早的选择可能产生后续义务、启用后续选项、使后续答案可被推断，或消除后续决策，从而在共享的咨询预算下产生延续效应。 每个任务族都有一个耦合版本，其中这些依赖关系源自较早的决策；同时还有一个匹配的对照版本，其中相同的触发因素依赖于独立的公共随机性。 每个决策只有一次咨询机会。 TB-H 采用顺序方式评估。

paragraphs.en: TB-H episodes for different reveal sets are independent executor runs that share the hidden completion but not the execution prefix. After switching episodes, earlier choices and visible workflow state can differ from those already observed, and terminal utility is the final episode’s full checkpoint sum. TB-H training targets, adaptive-policy results, and the adaptive normalization reference therefore use an approximate replay process; exact equivalence to chronological trajectories is not assumed. Prefix inconsistencies affect 45 % 45\% of CVD’s Sonnet 5 test paths in the uncoupled variant ( 81 / 180 81/180 across three training runs). Restricting to paths without inconsistent switches for either CVD or Local Value yields a Sonnet 5 utility gap of + 0.53 +0.53 (95% CI [ 0.18 , 0.91 ] [0.18,0.91] ), compared with + 0.70 +0.70 over all paths. This post-hoc restriction changes the evaluated subset and does not validate chronological execution. Missing arrivals occur in 337 337 of 472,875 472{,}875 Sonnet and 363 363 of 482,432 482{,}432 Sol DP lookups; these counts measure absent slots, not prefix consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 不同揭示集合的 TB-H 回合是相互独立的执行器运行，它们共享隐藏完成结果，但不共享执行前缀。 切换回合后，先前的选择和可见的工作流状态可能与已观察到的不同，而终端效用是最后一个回合的完整检查点总和。 因此，TB-H 训练目标、自适应策略结果以及自适应归一化参考都使用近似重放过程；不假设与按时间顺序的轨迹完全等价。 在非耦合变体中，前缀不一致影响 CVD 的 Sonnet 5 测试路径的 45\%（三次训练运行中共 81/180）。 仅限 CVD 或 Local Value 均无不一致切换的路径时，Sonnet 5 的效用差距为 +0.53（95% CI [0.18, 0.91]），而所有路径上的差距为 +0.70。 这种事后限定改变了所评估的子集，并不能验证按时间顺序的执行。 在 Sonnet 的 472{,}875 次 DP 查找中有 337 次缺失到达，在 Sol 的 482{,}432 次 DP 查找中有 363 次缺失到达；这些计数衡量的是缺失的槽位，而非前缀一致性。

paragraphs.en: We use the released value estimator of Dong et al. (2026) (commit 27466a7 ) with its one-step lookahead, changing only the LLM transport. Its belief model uses the executor model and settings for Animals and Flight. We adapt allocation to the benchmark’s fixed candidate pool and budget: batch Animals and Flight rank candidates once at the empty history and select the top B B ; sequential Animals recomputes VoI for every remaining question after each observed answer and asks the highest-scoring question. Both settings spend exactly B B consultations, with no stopping rule and zero communication cost. Exact ties are averaged, and results are means over three independent runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Dong 等人发布的价值估计器。 （2026）（commit 27466a7），保留其单步前瞻，仅更换 LLM 传输部分。 其信念模型在 Animals 和 Flight 任务中使用执行者模型及相应设置。 我们将分配策略适配到该基准的固定候选池和预算：批量模式的 Animals 和 Flight 在空历史时对候选问题进行一次性排序并选出前 B 个；顺序模式的 Animals 在每次观测到答案后为剩余的每个问题重新计算 VoI，并提出得分最高的问题。 两种设置都恰好进行 B 次咨询，没有停止规则，通信成本为零。 精确平局取平均值，结果为三次独立运行的均值。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether state coupling increases the benefit of continuation-aware allocation, we add 36 matched coupled/control pairs from the original TB-H generator: 12 per workflow family, using seeds 30000 30000 – 30011 30011 . Together with the original 15 pairs, this gives 51 pairs (102 worlds). paragraphs.en: On the new pairs alone and in the pooled evaluation, CVD significantly outperforms Local Value in both variants under both executors. In the pooled evaluation, its advantage is smaller under coupling with Sonnet 5 and does not differ significantly with GPT-6.1 Sol. These results show that the benefit of continuation-aware allocation is not confined to state-coupled workflows. Even in the control variant, consulting now consumes capacity that may be more valuable at a later decision. This finding does not imply that state coupling is irrelevant to allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在新增配对上以及在合并评估中，CVD 在两种变体下、于两种执行器上都显著优于 Local Value。 在合并评估中，其优势在与 Sonnet 5 耦合时较小，而在 GPT-6.1 Sol 下无显著差异。 这些结果表明，具备延续感知的分配所带来的收益并不局限于状态耦合的工作流。 即使在对照变体中，咨询现在也会消耗可能在后续决策中更有价值的容量。 这一发现并不意味着状态耦合与分配无关。

paragraphs.en: In the batch setting, consultation value is independent of the deployment budget B B , which only restricts the feasible consultation sets. Our DeepSets predictor is cardinality-agnostic and can therefore be reused when B B changes. Prior work has demonstrated DeepSets models evaluated on substantially larger sets than those observed during training ( Zaheer et al., 2017 ) . Thus, increasing the budget does not require a new model or retraining from scratch. If the new budget introduces set sizes absent from training, however, their values are extrapolations, and additional larger-set supervision may be useful for fine-tuning. In the sequential setting, continuation value depends explicitly on the remaining budget b t b_{t} , so the predictor is trained with b t b_{t} as an input and is most naturally reused within the budget range covered during training.
paragraphs.zh: 在批量设定下，咨询价值与部署预算 B B 无关，该预算仅限制可行的咨询集合。 我们的 DeepSets 预测器与基数无关，因此在 B B 变化时可以复用。 已有工作表明，DeepSets 模型可以在远大于训练时所见集合的集合上进行评估（ Zaheer et al., 2017 ）。 因此，提高预算不需要新模型，也不需要从头重新训练。 然而，如果新预算引入了训练中未出现过的集合规模，其价值属于外推，此时额外的更大规模集合监督可能有助于微调。 在序贯设定下，延续价值显式依赖于剩余预算 b t b_{t} ，因此预测器在训练时以 b t b_{t} 作为输入，并且最自然的复用方式是在训练所覆盖的预算范围内进行。

paragraphs.en: Table 20 provides the full diagnostics for the cross-executor transfer experiment summarized in the main paper. In addition to transfer performance, we report the correlation between Sonnet 5 and GPT-6.1 Sol consultation values and how often their executor-specific predictors induce different allocations. Transfer is nearly lossless when the executors have similar consultation-value structure, as on Trip Planning and TB-D, but degrades when their values and resulting allocations differ substantially, as on Animals. Meeting Planning also shows that high value correlation does not guarantee symmetric transfer, while Flight Recommendation illustrates that supervision from another executor can sometimes outperform supervision from the target executor itself.
paragraphs.zh: 表 20 给出了正文中所总结的跨执行器迁移实验的完整诊断结果。 除迁移性能外，我们还报告了 Sonnet 5 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 咨询值之间的相关性，以及它们各自针对执行器的预测器在多大频率上导致不同的分配。 当执行器具有相似的咨询值结构时（如 Trip Planning 和 TB-D），迁移几乎是无损的；但当它们的值及由此产生的分配存在显著差异时（如 Animals），迁移性能会下降。 Meeting Planning 还表明，高的值相关性并不保证对称的迁移，而 Flight Recommendation 则说明，来自另一执行器的监督有时可以胜过来自目标执行器自身的监督。

sents.en: Transfer is nearly lossless when the executors have similar consultation-value structure, as on Trip Planning and TB-D, but degrades when their values and resulting allocations differ substantially, as on Animals.
sents.zh: 当执行器具有相似的咨询值结构时（如 Trip Planning 和 TB-D），迁移几乎是无损的；但当它们的值及由此产生的分配存在显著差异时（如 Animals），迁移性能会下降。

sents.en: Meeting Planning also shows that high value correlation does not guarantee symmetric transfer, while Flight Recommendation illustrates that supervision from another executor can sometimes outperform supervision from the target executor itself.
sents.zh: Meeting Planning 还表明，高的值相关性并不保证对称的迁移，而 Flight Recommendation 则说明，来自另一执行器的监督有时可以胜过来自目标执行器自身的监督。
